A [[human]] '''console guard''' served in an [[Unidentified Imperial factory facility|Imperial factory facility]] part of the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Prison Complex]] on [[Narkina 5]].<ref name="Narkina" /> During the [[Narkina 5 prison escape]], the console guard requested for backup after the prisoners on [[Level 5 (Narkina 5)|Level 5]] started to rebel, but was shot [[Death|dead]] by [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]].<ref name="One Way Out">{{Andor|One Way Out}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Console Guard was portrayed by [[Elliot Greene]] in the eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]."<ref name="Narkina" />
